annotations.title: Explain an error or stack trace + fix steps (AI)

description: Explain an error or stack trace + fix steps (AI) — Paste any error message or stack trace (error=, optional context= for language/framework/what you were doing) and get a plain-English explanation, the most likely root cause, ranked likely causes, concrete fix steps, what to check first, severity, a web search query and confidence. Offline pre-parse detects the language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, Rust, C#, Ruby, PHP, SQL), the headline error and the top stack frame. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
